name: The session ended in another tab: the websocket does not reconnect with the dead token, shows the popup and stops
description: The renewal on reconnect fails (the OIDC provider answers that the session is over), the client stops and the popup names the websocket request. "No" does not restart the reconnects.
descriptionHtml:
